trigger_or_action.reason: Attacker sandwiches liquidity addition via mempool monitoring; block.timestamp deadline and no TWAP validation enable immediate execution.

direct_effect.reason: Protocol adds liquidity at unfavorable rate, receiving less liquidity value than provided; value captured by MEV bot.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual value relation: protocol should receive fair liquidity value for assets provided, but price manipulation causes less value received.

summary: Report identifies the vulnerable function/contract, the sandwich-attack trigger, the direct value-extraction effect, and a fair-value expected-vs-actual relation sufficient to attempt formalization.
